name: com.plairsoft/airsoft
title: Plairsoft
description: Airsoft games, events and fields in Spain, Portugal, Colombia and Brazil, from plairsoft.com.

tools.name: buscar_partidas
tools.description: Use when someone wants to play airsoft (partidas, jogos) in a city, province/state or country covered by Plairsoft: Spain, Portugal, Colombia and Brazil, optionally between dates or under a price. Returns up to 5 upcoming games with local date and time, field, place, price, free spots, status, a «ref» for ver_partida and the link to each game on plairsoft.com, where sign-up and payment happen, plus a link to every game in the area. For milsims, tournaments and other events there is buscar_eventos; to discover fields, buscar_campos.

lugar.description: City, province/state or country as the person says it, in any language: «Valencia», «Lisbon», «Medellín», «Portugal». Never coordinates.

pais.description: Country code if known: ES (Spain), PT (Portugal), CO (Colombia) or BR (Brazil). Without it, the place is looked up in all four.

desde.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

precio_maximo.description: Maximum price per person, in the country's currency.

tools.name: buscar_eventos
tools.description: Use when someone looks for airsoft events (milsim, tacsim, tournaments, courses, special games) in Spain, Portugal, Colombia or Brazil, by place, type or dates. Returns up to 5 events with dates, type, organizer, venue, starting price, free spots, status, a «ref» for ver_evento and the link to each event on plairsoft.com, where tickets are bought, plus a link to the country's event listing. For regular games at a field there is buscar_partidas.

lugar.description: City, province/state or country as the person says it, in any language: «Valencia», «Lisbon», «Medellín», «Portugal». Never coordinates.

pais.description: Country code if known: ES (Spain), PT (Portugal), CO (Colombia) or BR (Brazil). Without it, the place is looked up in all four.

tipo.description: Event type, in any language: milsim, tacsim, tournament (torneo), course (curso), special game (partida especial), private game.

desde.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

tools.name: buscar_campos
tools.description: Use when someone asks which airsoft fields (campos, sites to play) exist in a city, province/state or country covered by Plairsoft: Spain, Portugal, Colombia and Brazil, or where they can play nearby. Returns up to 5 open fields with their area, player rating, a «ref» for ver_campo and the link to each field on plairsoft.com (photos, reviews, upcoming games), plus a link to every field in the area. For games on specific dates there is buscar_partidas.

lugar.description: City, province/state or country as the person says it, in any language: «Valencia», «Lisbon», «Medellín», «Portugal». Never coordinates.

pais.description: Country code if known: ES (Spain), PT (Portugal), CO (Colombia) or BR (Brazil). Without it, the place is looked up in all four.

solo_con_partidas.description: Only fields with upcoming games published.

tools.name: ver_partida
tools.description: Use when someone wants more detail about one airsoft game returned by buscar_partidas or ver_campo, with its «ref». Adds the sign-up and cancellation deadlines (when the field sets them), teams, maximum muzzle energy per role in joules (pistol, rifle, DMR, sniper…), whether minors are allowed and the terrain, with the link to the game on plairsoft.com.

ref.description: The «ref» of a search result from this conversation. Valid for 24 hours; it cannot be built by hand.

tools.name: ver_evento
tools.description: Use when someone wants more detail about one airsoft event returned by buscar_eventos, with its «ref». Adds ticket types with price and remaining spots, sessions, the sign-up deadline, maximum muzzle energy in joules and whether minors are allowed, with the link to the event on plairsoft.com.

ref.description: The «ref» of a search result from this conversation. Valid for 24 hours; it cannot be built by hand.

tools.name: ver_campo
tools.description: Use when someone wants more detail about one airsoft field returned by buscar_campos or another result, with its «ref». Adds ratings for refereeing, facilities and organization, terrain, services, whether minors are allowed, maximum muzzle energy in joules, its next games (up to 5, each with its own «ref») and up to 3 similar fields nearby with their distance and link, with the link to the field on plairsoft.com.

ref.description: The «ref» of a search result from this conversation. Valid for 24 hours; it cannot be built by hand.
